highlights.text: Broke down in tears while watching Sidharth Shukla on screen.
Received a reality check from host Salman Khan during Weekend Ka Vaar.
Broke down in tears after watching the emotional legacy video featuring Sidharth Shukla and Shehnaaz Gill.
Labeled her co-contestants 'chhote chhote panchi' and declared that her game is much bigger than theirs.
Clashed fiercely with Amrapali Dubey over a food-related joke concerning Uditi Singh.
Stated that she gets bored as soon as gossip starts inside the house.
Playfully called Amrapali Dubey 'Bhabhi' during a chat.
Cleared the air with Amrapali Dubey over her 'Bhabhi' comment
Deemed the season a 'divorcee special', noting it marks a second innings for herself, Isha Rikhi, and Mary Kom.
Received a supportive shout-out from ex-husband Jay Bhanushali on her entry.
Joined Amrapali Dubey in a heated argument against Arishfa Khan.
Sparks house tension over housework duties, leading to heated exchanges with Aman Gandhi and Isha Rikhi.
Ex-husband Jay Bhanushali extended public support online as she entered the house.
Joined Bigg Boss 20 after years of persistent invitations from show producers.
